title: Grateful Dead Live at St. Paul Auditorium on 1973-02-17
lineage: DAT/0 (Tascam DA-40) > Tascam DA-3000 > Samplitude Pro X5 Suite > FLAC
source: SBD > Reel Master (7.5ips 1/2trk) > Reel/1 (7.5ips/Dolby B) > DAT/0 (Panasonic SV-3800/48k)

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a classic early‑'73 marathon, highlighted by the smoking Here Comes Sunshine → China Cat Sunflower → The Other One sequence and soaring Jerry solos.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers a clean, mostly crisp soundboard feed with only occasional bumps on a few tracks, making it very listenable. Musically the show is a three‑hour, 29‑song beast that deadheads rave about – from the magical HCS > China > Rider segue and Birdsong to scorching solos on Playing In The Band and Big River. Overall the performance feels inspired and the band is in top form.

ai_rating.rationale: All but one reviewer give five‑star praise for both the show and the soundboard quality; the lone low rating focuses on minor sound glitches, so the weighted average favours a high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally crisp and well‑balanced soundboard recording; occasional bumpy sections (e.g., Promised Land/He's Gone) but no major dropouts. No matrix source found.

standout_songs: Here Comes Sunshine > China Cat Sunflower > The Other One
show_quality.setlist_flow: A 3‑hour, 29‑song marathon with strong segues (notably HCS > China > Rider) and a mix of high‑energy rockers and delicate 'tiny music' moments; the pacing keeps momentum while allowing deep jams.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Hot, soaring solos on Playing In The Band, Here Comes Sunshine and Birdsong; deft navigation throughout.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass shines especially on Box of Rain and his intro on Loose Lucy; generally prominent and lively.
band_member_comments.Bob: Vocal counterpoint praised; shines on several numbers including the first set highlights.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith's subtle flourishes on Birdsong and other jams noted; Donna Jean’s vocals receive special commendation throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill's solid backbeat highlighted, particularly on Big River and driving sections of Truckin'.
